Name: Mona Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I always adored Zilsara's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3244]New NPC Mona[/url]. She's been around for a hot minute and I have always kept her in my mod list. Sadly, 1.6 broke her a little bit, so I reached out to Zilsara to see if I could possibly bring her back, and they said yes!

Mona is a refugee from the war. She's friends with Haley and Emily, who told her Gus had a spare room when she needed one. She loves to read and eat what the residents of Pelican Town would probably call exotic food. She spends a lot of time at the beach and library. Get to know her!

Mona is fully romanceable, has a full schedule and dialogue, and heart events:
[list]
[*]2 hearts :  at Haley and Emily's house, any time, any day[/*]
[*]5 hearts : at the beach, sunny weather, between 8am and 6pm, every day except winter[/*]
[*]8 hearts : at the Museum, sunny weather, between 12am and 6pm, every day except winter[/*]
[*]10 hearts : invitation by mail, starts at the bus stop, sunny weather, between 6am and 12am, every day except winter[/*]
[/list]﻿ 
Mona will attend festivals, and should be compatible with SVE. She's also seasonably configurable.

Enjoy!

*NOTE: As of 1.4, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30194]Saloon Second Floor[/url] is a requirement, as Mona has moved into a room in the saloon.
